title: DeactivateFlow
wrapsNative: MonarchBottomSheet with rememberModalBottomSheetState(confirmValueChange) to stop dismissal while working, holding a verticalScroll Column of MonarchText, MonarchConsequenceList, MonarchTextField, MonarchInlineNotice and MonarchButtons
summary: A recipe, not a component: confirm a reversible pause (a partnership, a tracker, a person) in a sheet that says where to turn it back on, lists what changes meanwhile and can record a reason; the same sheet confirms reactivation.
whenToUse: Before pausing something that can be turned back on and keeps its data, when the person should see what stops working meanwhile and may give a reason.
whenNotToUse: For something that cannot be undone, such as deleting, use the confirm dialog (an MonarchDialog with a danger MonarchButton) or MonarchTypeToConfirmInput. For a pause with no consequences and no reason, a MonarchDialog with a primary button is enough.
api: ModalBottomSheet(onDismissRequest = { if (!working) open = false }, sheetState = rememberModalBottomSheetState(skipPartiallyExpanded = true, confirmValueChange = { !working })) { … }
MonarchConsequenceList(items: List<MonarchConsequence>, heading = "While it is deactivated")
MonarchTextField(value = reason, onValueChange = …, label = "Reason (optional)", helperText = "Kept with the change history.")
MonarchButton(text = "Deactivate", onClick = …, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary, loading = working)

options.name: deactivated
options.description: The app's state of the thing: false asks to deactivate, true asks to reactivate.

options.name: reason
options.description: The optional reason, sent with the request only when it is not blank.

options.name: working
options.description: Passed to the confirm button's loading while the request runs; it also stops the sheet from being dismissed.

options.name: failure
options.description: A failed request, shown in a danger MonarchInlineNotice above the buttons; the sheet stays open.

states.name: deactivate
states.description: Title "Deactivate …?", the description that nothing is deleted, the line saying where to reactivate, what changes while it is deactivated, the optional reason and Deactivate.

states.name: reactivate
states.description: Title "Reactivate …?", what changes once it is back, and Reactivate; no reversibility line and no reason.

states.name: working
states.description: The confirm button shows its progress indicator, Cancel and the reason are disabled, and the sheet cannot be swiped or backed away.

states.name: failed
states.description: The error in a danger MonarchInlineNotice above the buttons; the sheet stays open so the person can retry or cancel.

appearance: Every part is an existing Monarch component in the theme on the Material 3 sheet surface: the title in the title style, the consequence list with its kind marks, the text field with its helper text, and a full-width primary button over a ghost Cancel. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from those components.
platformNotes: The web DeactivateFlow is a warning-toned ConfirmDialog. On Android a MonarchDialog has room for neither a consequence list nor a text field, so, as on iOS, the recipe uses a MonarchBottomSheet with a primary (not danger) confirm button, since nothing is deleted; Monarch has no warning button variant. The web's mode, subject and reactivateFrom props become the app's own state and strings in the recipe. rememberModalBottomSheetState's confirmValueChange keeps the sheet open while the request runs, where iOS uses interactiveDismissDisabled. The parity map lists confirm-dialog: the dialog is replaced by the sheet for the reason above.
accessibility: The title uses the title style, which MonarchText marks as a heading.
The reversibility line is plain text, read in order after the description.
MonarchConsequenceList reads each consequence with its kind, not by its mark's color alone.
The reason field is a MonarchTextField with its label and helper text.
Buttons are MonarchButtons with 48dp touch targets and a busy state while working; the sheet cannot be dismissed while the request runs.
edgeCases: If the request fails, keep the sheet open with the error so the person can retry or cancel.
Send the reason with the request only when it is not blank.
Offer reactivation from the place the reversibility line names, so the promise in the line is true.
